title: Cookie box covers the bottom of the first screen
what_happened: As soon as the page loaded, a cookie box covered the bottom third of my phone screen, right over the sentence telling me what they do.
expected: A small strip I can ignore, not something sitting on the words I'm trying to read.

title: Opening words are jargon, no hint of who it's for
what_happened: "Cross-functional or cross-industry, structured or unstructured" — I don't know what that means for a cleaning company. Nothing on the first screen says whether they work with small businesses like mine.
expected: One plain sentence like "we help small businesses and nonprofits use AI to cut paperwork", with an example.

title: Three screens and still no word on who they help
what_happened: I scrolled through three screens: the headline, "every company has a barrier to growth", and now "market assessments, go-to-market strategy, operational leverage". None of it says whether they work with a twelve-person cleaning company or a food pantry. This sounds like it's for big corporations.
expected: Somewhere early, plain words on who they work with (small businesses? nonprofits?) and one real example, like "we helped a 10-person firm cut invoicing time in half".
